image_pattern_summary: No verified good products were found in this batch — all 10 items were classified as bad due to wrong material (steel/FRP instead of wood), wrong product type (steel office containers instead of wooden log cabins), or cross-dimension contradictions. Good image patterns for Portable Log Cabins should show: wooden exterior walls (log-profile, tongue-and-groove, or plank siding), gabled or pitched roof with natural timber framing, and an outdoor/natural setting (hillside, garden, or resort context). The two items with genuine wooden cabin images (98868596, 163499976) were overridden to bad due to text contradictions, but their images represent the correct visual pattern for this MCAT.
